Hold and release Overrides take effect at the next solve and the next table write. At the monitor tier nothing is written to the inverter: a hold or release changes the recommendation. Hold Release to native Pause writes Resume Overrides in force Clear one to let the plan run as solved again. A pause and a forced charge are cleared by an administrator. No override is in force: the plan runs as solved. What the plan would set Huawei SUN2000, fourteen TOU periods. Recommended only: nothing is sent at the monitor tier. Fallback What the inverter does on its own when no plan holds. If the plan expires, or no fresh plan arrives for 3.0 h, the inverter returns to its native settings and keeps at least 20 % state of charge.
